newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes slightly lower.

text.p: The Czech PX50 again closed down on Monday with turnover staying low and major issues showing no sign of a turnaround.
The PX50 dropped 0.6 percent to 535.4 while the major issue dominated RPIX fell by the same amount to 1,117.4.

Zivnostenska Banka was one of the biggest decliners, dropped 130 crowns, 4.9 percent, to 2,480 after posting audited 1996 net profits of 378 million crowns down from 406 million crowns the year before.
The figures were calculated according to international accounting standards. -- Robin Shepherd, Prague Newsroom, 420-2-2423-0003
